always_on.method: 0012-prereg.txt part B. Each run: a fresh worktree at 96e82e6 with 39cb68e's tests/ from an unauthenticated scratch clone; bwrap --unshare-net (loopback only); a capture stub on 127.0.0.1 that records the request (credential headers redacted) and answers 400; dsh with a placeholder key and DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL at the stub, scratch HOME, DSH_HOME and DSH_AGENTS_HOME, TMPDIR per run, DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1, env -u DSH_PERMISSION_MODE -u DEEPSEEK_API_KEY -u DSH_SYSTEM_PROMPT, timeout 300 s. The owner's key was never read. Prompt = system text + tools as wire JSON (compact, key order as sent) + message texts of the first POST */v1/messages, counted offline.
always_on.counting_basis: prompt_tokens (5,835) and every delta here count the first request's prompt texts: system text, tools as wire JSON (compact, key order as sent) and message texts, the probe's 13 tokens included (5,823 without the probe text); ADR 0011's 5,825 is on the same basis. raw_body_tokens (6,013) count the whole JSON body of 27,449 bytes as one string, escapes included, the basis of ADR 0009's 6,003 (27,428 bytes) and of 0011's raw figure.
always_on.identity: One sha256 per part across all six runs once the run's working directory is replaced by '<RUN>': system 90dcab5e7001b05f8005523d6e484bb52d20f014248eaf0c2a6bad47ce288086, tools d45ce9636b4775c5c9941269f5028381adfb66a7c04dfbe98ef53927b42a8a46, user message ca6005edcf812f72c6e67aafc6b7615c79b490b97d504521cdbdcc4fd6727218, other fields 9735194ce81f3326c0a43e75fd578ca37915fd5c649cdd3505739fb307bd193a, whole body b9db4f6d91f35222513fb7345b0a2a3da9e850c67bbc45809a3e05ce6224ffac. The six raw bodies have six different sha256, because each holds its own worktree name (ab-0012-<arm letter>-c<n>); the names were of equal length, so the raw counts are identical.

first_series_stop: The first series stopped at 01:59 ET before its second probe. Its guard, pgrep -f ibgateway, matched a concurrent Claude Code measurement whose command line carried the deny rule Bash(*ibgateway*); port 4002 had no listener and no Gateway process ran: a false alarm. The second series used 0012_gateway_guard.sh, which matches process names and executables, never command lines.
